title: Hike the Rockies Half Day Tour
includes: Complimentary Snowshoes and poles provided when needed
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This guided hike of the Rockies is with a small group of 8 or fewer guests. Our knowledgeable trained guides are locals so they can describe the many ecosystems and wildlife that you may see on your tour so you can have a wonderful experience Seeing, Learning and Exploring the beautiful Rocky Mountains.
